elixirs.description: For the current player, 25% of all stamina used is given right back!  (Effect wears off when player runs out of Stamina)
Highlights an area on the floor.  The hole to the next depth is guaranteed to be in that area!
Gives the current player a 50% chance to regenerate  30% Stamina when they run out.  (Cannot be used a 2nd time while the effect is active)
Boosts your amber gain by +1% per 10 stamina used during the delve  at the time this elixir was used.  (Effect persists for the entire Delve)
Boosts POW to 5x your normal amount.  However, you now lose 20% POW each time you descend!  (Effect persists for the entire Delve)
For the next 2 depths, whenever an object is destroyed it has a 60% chance of hitting an adjacent object with the power of your Hammer tool.
All objects have a +25% chance of dropping Double Amber  instead of a single amber chunk  (Effect lasts for the entire Delve)
Shadow Strikes are 1.5x more common,  and have a +30% higher chance to trigger a multi strike  (Effect lasts for the entire Delve)
Increases Stamina Costs by 2x, reduces POW by 100x, but boosts Grand Discovery chance by 5x
Increases Stamina Costs by 4x, boosts POW by 100x.  Each use adds a stack of this effect, so 8x and 200x on the 2nd use.  (Effect persists for the entire Delve)
This elixir doesn't have a label on it. At least, that's what the label says...
